app "Water" drop ocean
table drink ml num 1..5000 unit "ml", kind pick Water|Tea|Juice|Milk = Water
setting goal num = 2000 "Daily goal (ml)"
let ml = sum(drink.ml today)
let p = clamp(ml / goal, 0, 1)
row gap 4 align center
  draw 56, 108 width 88
    rect 8, 104 - 100 * p, 40, 100 * p fill accent
    path "M6 4h44l-6 100H12z" stroke ink thick 2
  stack grow gap 1
    ml "ml" big
    "of" goal "ml today" color muted tap edit goal
    if ml >= goal
      "Goal reached" bold color good
    else
      text goal - ml "ml to go" bold
row gap 1
  button "+ 250 ml" fill accent grow tap add drink ml = 250
  button "+ 150 ml" grow tap add drink ml = 150
  button "+ 500 ml" grow tap add drink ml = 500
section "Today", plural(count(drink today), "drink")
  each drink today as d empty "Nothing yet today. Tap + 250 ml when you have a glass."
    row tap edit d swipe remove d
      d.kind grow
      d.ml "ml" bold
section "Last 7 days", "Goal met on" count(days last 7 days, sum(drink.ml on it) >= goal) "of 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(drink.ml on it), goal, "Reached the goal (the dark line)"

app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
state sel date = today
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
topbar habit, "Add habit", "Save habit"
if n = 0
  stack card gap 2
    "No habits yet" head
    "Add one small thing you can do even on a busy day, like reading two pages." color muted
else
  row gap 4 align center
    draw width 104
      circle 42 stroke soft thick 10
      arc 42, 0, 360 * clamp(done / n, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 10
      label 50, 50, done "/" n head
    stack grow gap 1
      done "of" n "done today" head
      if done >= n
        "All done. See you tomorrow." color good
      else
        n - done "left for today" color muted
  each habit as h
    stack card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      row gap 2
        stack grow gap 0
          h.name bold
          if streak(h.check) > 0
            streak(h.check) "day streak," round(count(h.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
          else
            "Not started yet. Tick it today." faint
        toggle h.check
      weekdots count(h.check on it) > 0
  stack card gap 3
    row gap 3
      stack gap 0
        "This week" faint
        round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Last 30 days" faint
        round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Best streak" faint
        plural(max(habit, streak(it.check)), "day") head
        "running now" faint
  row
    "Last 6 weeks" head grow
    "Average" round(count(check last 42 days) * 100 / (n * 42)) "%" faint
  grid 7 gap 0
    each 1..7
      dayname(today - 42 + it) tiny color muted align center
    each days last 42 days
      box height 44 pad 1 radius 8 stroke if(sel = it, ink, bg) thick 2 tap set sel = it
        box height 28 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity if(count(check on it) > 0, clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1), 1)
        it "," count(check on it) "of" n "habits done" opacity 0
  row gap 1 align center
    "Less" faint
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill soft
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.3
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent
    "More" faint
    space
    sel bold
    count(check on sel) "of" n "done" color muted

app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other = Groceries
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

table deposit amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 100000 "Savings goal"
state adding bool = no
state d new deposit
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let p = clamp(total / goal, 0, 1)
let mon(d date) = if(month(d) = 1, "Jan", if(month(d) = 2, "Feb", if(month(d) = 3, "Mar", if(month(d) = 4, "Apr", if(month(d) = 5, "May", if(month(d) = 6, "Jun", if(month(d) = 7, "Jul", if(month(d) = 8, "Aug", if(month(d) = 9, "Sep", if(month(d) = 10, "Oct", if(month(d) = 11, "Nov", "Dec")))))))))))
row gap 4 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 72
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow gap 1
    "Saved so far" color muted
    total big
    round(p * 100) "% of" goal color muted tap edit goal

    each [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]
      rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, 0 - it)) fill if(it = 0, accent, muted) radius 3
      tick index + 0.5, mon(addmonths(today, 0 - it))
  "Rupees saved each month; this month in colour" faint
"Deposits" head
each deposit sort at desc top 12 as r empty "Nothing saved yet. Tap + 1,000 to make the first deposit."
  row card tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.note
      r.at faint
    r.amount bold

setting target num = 33 "Count to"
state ph text = SubhanAllah
let n = count(zikr today where phrase = ph)
row gap 1
  each options zikr.phrase

app "My Daily Log" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other = Groceries
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

app "Daily Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
state sel date = today
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
topbar habit, "Add habit", "Save habit"
if n = 0
  stack card gap 2
    "No habits yet" head
    "Add one small thing you can do even on a busy day, like reading two pages." color muted
else
  row gap 4 align center
    draw width 104
      circle 42 stroke soft thick 10
      arc 42, 0, 360 * clamp(done / n, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 10
      label 50, 50, done "/" n head
    stack grow gap 1
      done "of" n "done today" head
      if done >= n
        "All done. See you tomorrow." color good
      else
        n - done "left for today" color muted
  each habit as h
    stack card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      row gap 2
        stack grow gap 0
          h.name bold
          if streak(h.check) > 0
            streak(h.check) "day streak," round(count(h.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
          else
            "Not started yet. Tick it today." faint
        toggle h.check
      weekdots count(h.check on it) > 0
  stack card gap 3
    row gap 3
      stack gap 0
        "This week" faint
        round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Last 30 days" faint
        round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Best streak" faint
        plural(max(habit, streak(it.check)), "day") head
        "running now" faint
  row
    "Last 6 weeks" head grow
    "Average" round(count(check last 42 days) * 100 / (n * 42)) "%" faint
  grid 7 gap 0
    each 1..7
      dayname(today - 42 + it) tiny color muted align center
    each days last 42 days
      box height 44 pad 1 radius 8 stroke if(sel = it, ink, bg) thick 2 tap set sel = it
        box height 28 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity if(count(check on it) > 0, clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1), 1)
        it "," count(check on it) "of" n "habits done" opacity 0
  row gap 1 align center
    "Less" faint
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill soft
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.3
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent
    "More" faint
    space
    sel bold
    count(check on sel) "of" n "done" color muted

app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
state q text = ""
state writing bool = no
let wrote = count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0)
row bar
  button if(writing, "Close", "Write") fill if(writing, soft, accent) tap set writing = not writing
stack gap 0
  if count(entry today) > 0
    "You wrote today" head
  else
    "Nothing written today yet" head
  if streak(entry) > 0
    plural(streak(entry), "day") "in a row," wrote "of the last 14 days" faint
if writing
  stack card gap 3
    "How are you feeling?" head
    row gap 1
      each ["Rough", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
        stack grow gap 1 align center radius 10 pad 1 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
          draw 20, 12 width 28
            each 1..5 as b
              rect 4 * b - 4, 12 - 2.4 * b, 3, 2.4 * b fill if(b <= index + 1, ink, edge) radius 0.6
          it small
    field d.note "What happened today?"
    row gap 2
      "Saved on this device only" faint grow
      button "Save entry" fill accent tap save d then set writing = no
stack card gap 3
  row
    "Mood, last 30 days" head grow
    "This week" round(avg(entry.mood week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
  if count(entry last 30 days) < 2
    "Write on two days to see your mood line." color muted
  else
    plot 0..30, 1..5 axes gridlines
      poly stroke accent thick 2
        each entry last 30 days sort at
          pt 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood
      each entry last 30 days
        circle 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood, 1 fill accent
      ytick 5, "Great"
      ytick 3, "Okay"
      ytick 1, "Rough"
      tick 1, today - 29
      tick 29, "Today"
    "Last week averaged" round(avg(entry.mood prev week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
"Recent" head
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
if q = "" and count(entry) = 0
  "No entries yet. Tap Write, pick a mood and write a line." color muted
each entry where has(note, q) by day as g
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    stack card gap 1 tap edit r swipe remove r
      if(r.mood >= 4, "Good day", if(r.mood = 3, "Okay day", "Hard day")) faint color if(r.mood >= 4, good, if(r.mood = 3, muted, warn))
      r.note

cases.out:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other|Health证 = Groceries
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

  button if(adding, "Close", "Add task") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding

    stack grow gap 0
      t.title bold
      if t.due < today
        "Late, was due" t.due "·" t.tag faint color bad

  "Done" count(task where done = yes) head grow

app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long, section pick Sent|Seeing| heard = Sent
state d new entry
state q text = ""
state writing bool = no
let wrote = count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0)
row bar
  button if(writing, "Close", "Write") fill if(writing, soft, accent) tap set writing = not writing
stack gap 0
  if count(entry today) > 0
    "You wrote today" head
  else
    "Nothing written today yet" head
  if streak(entry) > 0
    plural(streak(entry), "day") "in a row," wrote "of the last 14 days" faint
if writing
  stack card gap 3
    "How are you feeling?" head
    row gap 1
      each ["Rough", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
        stack grow gap 1 align center radius 10 pad 1 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
          draw 20, 12 width 28
            each 1..5 as b
              rect 4 * b - 4, 12 - 2.4 * b, 3, 2.4 * b fill if(b <= index + 1, ink, edge) radius 0.6
          it small
    field d.note "What happened today?"

      "Saved on this device only" faint grow
      button "Save entry" fill accent tap save d then set writing = no
stack card gap 3
  row
    "Mood, last 30 days" head grow
    "This week" round(avg(entry.mood week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint

        each entry last 30 days sort at
          pt 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood
      each entry last 30 days
        circle 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood, 1 fill accent

      ytick 3, "Okay"

      tick 1, today - 29

    "Last week averaged" round(avg(entry.mood prev week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
"Recent" head
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
if q = "" and count(entry) = 0
  "No entries yet. Tap Write, pick a mood and write a line." color muted
each entry where has(note, q) by day as g
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    stack card gap 1 tap edit r swipe remove r
      if(r.mood >= 4, "Good day", if(r.mood = 3, "Okay day", "Hard day")) faint color if(r.mood >= 4, good, if(r.mood = 3, muted, warn))
      r.note

app "To do" list ink
table task title text, due date?, done bool, tag pick Home|Work|Other = Home
state adding bool = no
state showdone bool = no

let late = count(task where done = no and due < today)
let open = count(task where done = no)

  button if(adding, "Close", "Add task") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding

  each task where done = yes as t
    row gap 2 swipe remove t
      toggle t.done
      t.title color muted grow

state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend

  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines

      each days month of m

          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent

    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)

    "Tap to filter" faint

    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)

        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2

        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
section "All"
  each spend month of m where section = Evening by day as g empty "Nothing here.Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
    row gap 1
      g.key bold grow
      "spent" faint
      row gap 1
        draw 100, 4
          rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
          rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""

app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
state sel date = today
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
topbar habit, "Add habit", "Save habit"
  stack card gap 2
    "No habits yet" head
    "Add one small thing you can do even on a busy day, like reading two pages." color muted
else
  row gap 4 align center
    draw width 104
      circle 42 stroke soft thick 10
      arc 42, 0, 360 * clamp(done / n, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 10
      label 50, 50, done "/" n head
    stack grow gap 1
      done "of" n "done today" head
      if done >= n
        "All done. See you tomorrow." color good
      else
        n - done "left for today" color muted
  each habit as h
    stack card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      row gap 2
        stack grow gap 0
          h.name bold
          if streak(h.check) > 0
            streak(h.check) "day streak," round(count(h.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
          else
            "Not started yet. Tick it today." faint
        toggle h.check
      weekdots count(h.check on it) > 0
  stack card gap 3
    row gap 3
      stack gap 0
        "This week" faint
        round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Last 30 days" faint
        round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Best streak" faint
        plural(max(habit, streak(it.check)), "day") head
        "running now" faint
  row
    "Last 6 weeks" head grow
    "Average" round(count(check last 42 days) * 100 / (n * 42)) "%" faint
  grid 7 gap 0
    each 1..7
      dayname(today - 42 + it) tiny color muted align center
    each days last 42 days
      box height 44 pad 1 radius 8 stroke if(sel = it, ink, bg) thick 2 tap set sel = it
        box height 28 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity if(count(check on it) > 0, clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1), 1)
if n = 0
        it "," count(check on it) "of" n "habits done" opacity 0
  row gap 1 align center
    "Less" faint
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill soft
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.3
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent
    "More" faint
    space
    sel bold
    count(check on sel) "of" n "done" color muted

cases.out:
app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
state q text = ""
state writing bool = no
let wrote = count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0)
row bar
  button if(writing, "Close", "Write") fill if(writing, soft, accent) tap set writing = not writing
stack gap 0
  if count(entry today) > 0
    "You wrote today" head
  else
    "Nothing written today yet" head
  if streak(entry) > 0
    plural(streak(entry), "day") "in a row," wrote "of the last 14 days" faint
      field d.note "What happened today?"
  stack card gap 3
    "How are you feeling?" head
    row gap 1
      each ["Rough", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
        stack grow gap 1 align center radius 10 pad 1 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
          draw 20, 12 width 28
            each 1..5 as b
              rect 4 * b - 4, 12 - 2.4 * b, 3, 2.4 * b fill if(b <= index + 1, ink, edge) radius 0.6
          it small
    field d.note "What happened today?"
    row gap 2
      "Saved on this device only" faint grow
      button "Save entry" fill accent tap save d then set writing = no
stack card gap 3
  row
    "Mood, last 30 days" head grow
    "This week" round(avg(entry.mood week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
  if count(entry last 30 days) < 2
    "Write on two days to see your mood line." color muted
  else
    plot 0..30, 1..5 axes gridlines
      poly stroke accent thick 2
        each entry last 30 days sort at
          pt 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood
      each entry last 30 days
        circle 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood, 1 fill accent
      ick 5, "Great"
      ytick 3, "Okay"
      ytick 1, "Rough"
      tick 1, today - 29
      tick 29, "Today"
    "Last week averaged" round(avg(entry.mood prev week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
"Recent" head
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
    "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." color muted
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
if q = "" and count(entry) = 0
      "No entries yet. Tap Write, pick a mood and write a line." color muted
each entry where has(note, q) by day as g
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    stack card gap 1 tap edit r swipe remove r
      if(r.mood >= 4, "Good day", if(r.mood = 3, "Okay day", "Hard day")) faint color if(r.mood >= 4, good, if(r.mood = 3, muted, warn))
      r.note

cases.out:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other = Groceries, section text?
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

table task title text, due date?, done bool, tag pick Home|Work|Other = Home
state adding bool = no
state showdone bool = no

state d new task
let late = count(task where done = no and due < today)

  button if(adding, "Close", "Add task") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding

      else

  "Done" count(task where done = yes) head grow

    row gap 2 swipe remove t
